body.name: Certified full-label dual score
body.construction: Choose the lexicographically least solution \(\ell^\star\) of \[\max_{\ell\in\mathbb R^{S_c}}\ell^\top v\quad\text{subject to}\quad |\ell^\top b_t|\le\theta_t^2\ \text{for every }t\in\mathcal T_c,\] and put \(g^\star=\ell^\star/\kappa(c)\).
